title: Restock a wall-mounted twin-roll tissue dispenser and make the remaining roll available first
instruction: Restock the twin-roll tissue dispenser and leave it ready to dispense the remaining roll first.
context: Keeping a usable remaining roll while fitting a refill avoids waste and leaves a public or household washroom ready for its next user. The sliding panel must expose usable tissue from the remaining roll while keeping the new roll covered.
setup:
Coordinates are metres from the midpoint between the two robot bases: +x forward, +y left, z up. Two arms have bases at (0, +/-0.305, 0.750), starting in READY with closed fingers. Two wooden counter platforms, each 1.10 x 0.445 x 0.060 m, have top z=0.7475 and centres (0.360, +/-0.4275, 0.7175), leaving a 0.410 m service gap. Each platform has four 0.060 m square legs; a 0.020 x 0.410 m backboard supports the dispenser from the floor at x=0.516. The floor and these supports are physical parts of the setup.

The vertical, unbranded twin-roll cabinet is 0.490 m wide, 0.3005 m high and 0.140 m deep, with rear face x=0.500 and bottom z=0.7875. Fixed side/top walls surround a side-hinged ABS front cover, estimated complete assembly mass 0.60 kg, starting 90 degrees open about a vertical hinge at (0.370,0.245,0.7875). Its physical latch has a POM-C cam bolt, 19 x 14 x 12 mm triangular-prism envelope with the integral 6 mm square load tip inside that envelope; total solid mass 2.25036 g, spring 400 N/m, damping 0.8 N s/m, and 18 mm travel. These are engineering specifications, not measurements from an OEM dispenser.

Two fixed horizontal cylindrical supports, 77 mm diameter and 65 mm long, sit at y=+0.120 and -0.120, axis height z=0.93775, with rear shoulder x=0.489. Rolls turn freely around these supports by physical contact. The remaining roll starts on the y=-0.120 support: 115 mm outside diameter, 83.82 mm core opening, 86.36 mm width, mass 0.150 kg. The full refill starts on the cardboard platform at (0.34318,-0.520), top z=0.8075, with its axis horizontal: 223.52 mm outside diameter, 83.82 mm core opening, 86.36 mm width and mass 0.743891 kg. The remaining roll's residual paper/core dimensions and mass are estimates; refill size and mass follow the cited TJ0922A specification.

A continuous tissue tail, 86.36 mm wide and 350 mm long, remains attached to the remaining roll. It starts as a flat, stress-free sheet tangent to the inner upper side of the right old roll, 30 degrees above its inward horizontal radius. Its attached root line spans x=0.40264 to 0.48900, at y=-0.06934, z=0.96359 m. The 350 mm loose sheet extends diagonally left and down, with initial free edge at y=0.10566, z=0.66048 m, pre-threaded through the already open left outlet. The single 33-node root attachment is the only attachment; gravity, contact and self-collision remain active. This is a declared prepared maintenance state. The two bottom apertures span x=0.396 to0.494, y=-0.225 to-0.015 and y=0.015 to0.225, at z=0.7875. A captured ABS sliding panel, 224 mm wide with 240 mm travel and a thumb tab, starts in the maintenance position covering the y<0 aperture and leaving the y>0 aperture open. The final service configuration puts the remaining roll at y=+0.120, the new roll at y=-0.120, exposes accessible remaining-roll tissue, and covers the new-roll aperture.

A loose aluminium closing tool, estimated 0.3140208 kg from its six solid pieces at 2,700 kg/m3, rests with origin (0.160,0.500,0.7675). It has a 60 x 40 x 30 mm contact foot, an 8 x 48 x 8 mm neck, a 28 x 8 x 8 mm bridge, an 8 x 12 x 15 mm riser, an 18 x 20 x 50 mm handle and a 50 x 80 x 5 mm base. Its exact connected shape is supplied with the scene. It may be used, moved or left aside; full credit requires it clear of the dispenser, not returned to a prescribed rack. Fixed cabinet walls, supports and selector are ABS engineering equivalents; latch receiver and counter legs are steel, backboard/platforms wood, carton paperboard and closing tool aluminium. Exact original construction dimensions and initial transforms of all physical objects are in setup_manifest.json.
scoring: End-state score, except a real fall latches failure. Score 0 if either roll centre ever falls over 50 mm below the counter top, if the remaining roll finishes outside the cabinet, or if it is not seated left. Seated means rear axis within 6 mm axially and 6 mm radially of the support target, axis within 4 degrees. Otherwise: 0.25 for the remaining roll seated left; +0.20 for the refill seated right; +0.20 for cover within 2 degrees of shut and physical bolt returned within 3 mm; +0.15 for the panel fully exposing the remaining-roll aperture and blocking the refill aperture. +0.10 requires the same connected sheet attached within 2 mm, passing through the correct aperture, with one connected exposed terminal portion of at least 200 mm2 and its own continuous free edge spanning at least 20 mm. The qualifying portion lies outside and below the outlet within its vertical projection; its qualifying free-edge run is at least 20 mm below the outlet. Other corners may drape outside that projection. The complete terminal patch stays at least 4 mm above the actual floor. Final +0.10 requires both rolls, cover and panel below 10 mm/s and 0.25 rad/s, and all 630 robot collision pieces plus all six closing-tool pieces clear of device and paper by conservative 20 mm checks. Full 1.0 holds for 1 s with valid access and release. Natural sheet motion alone is not a failure. Invalid or incomplete geometry cannot earn full credit. Normal cover-closing speed is not a failure.
reset_notes: Reopen the cover to 90 degrees. Return the remaining roll to the right support and the refill to the cardboard platform. Preposition the manual selector to cover the right/refill aperture and leave the left aperture open. Keep the same 350 mm real loose tissue tail attached to the old roll along the declared inner-upper tangent root line, and thread the loose free edge through the open left aperture, matching the supplied initial geometry and settled reset screenshot. Do not add attachments or supports. Restore the loose closing tool and both arms to READY. The agent must transfer the old roll to the left support, fit the refill on the vacated right support, close/latch/release the cover and leave actual usable old-roll tissue. It need not move the already correctly positioned selector. The physical central gap and floor remain part of the reset.
fidelity: Unbranded manual-changeover equivalent. ABS cover mass 0.60 kg and POM-C bolt contact friction 0.35/0.25 (min combine) are estimates. Bolt mass 2.25036 g follows 1,410 kg/m3 density. Tissue is a flat 100 um deformable sheet, 28 g/m2, E=1 MPa, nu=0.25, with uncalibrated effective properties. Winding, tearing and fracture are omitted. Real supports, outlets, selector and contact latch are represented. The 350 mm tail starts pre-threaded through the open left outlet; only its root is attached.
scores: Final-source scripted and model qualification pending; no complete full-score trial yet.
